Brahmayāmala
tantra. traditionally believed to be in a lakh an. quarter verses. The present work in 1200 verses belongs to western school; one of the main sources for Narapatijayacaryāsvarodaya. See Intro. verses.
AS. p. 122. Kavīndrācārya 1154. Mithilā. Nabadwip 615. Nepal II. p.. 60-62. Oppert I. 6619. 6760. Radh 27. RASB. VII. A. 5892 (inc.). (agrees with the Narapatijayacaryā). Rep. Hpr. 1906-11, p. 3. SK. Ray 192. 210 (tha). TCD. 1103B (chs. 1-4). Tra. Ad. Rep. 1105. 52 (fr.). Trav. Uni. T. 982 (a. Vidyāpīṭha) (inc.). Varendra 1393. 1410.
For a Detailed notice of this See Bagchi, Studies in the Tantras p.. I. Calcutta, 1939, p.. 102-5.
